afterSuccessOnly.precondition: actual entire commonBuild exit0 including pipeline and generated-addition restoration, explicit restored source/journals and all current pins exact

ownerRecoveryAfterFailureOnly.first: After owned group cleanup and actual idle, preserve exact Library journal, pipeline record/Before/After, additions record/files, all logs and observed full current-source state. Record pending-restoration with both readiness flagsfalse.

legacyIfActualJournalExists.preconditions: Actual journal accepted by existing RecoverInterrupted revision/move/file rules and no simultaneous Unity/browser. Use a separately owned bounded invocation; preserve and stop on ambiguity. Never rerun original build to trigger recovery blindly.

pipelineIfActualRecordStillSnapshotted.preconditions: Unity fully exited; inspect original record status=snapshotted and every exact Before original exists; After directory must still be absent. Do not call this again if already restored or After exists in a partial/prepared state: preserve record/Before/After/current source and stop for explicit owner diagnosis, with no overwrite/delete/re-run.

generatedAdditionsIfNoPriorOutputYet.preconditions: Legacy and pipeline original bytes/GUID state recovered first; original fresh Native reference retained; GeneratedProjectAdditions absent, every changed old input absent and all extras fit existing original allowlist. If existing prepared/partial output, preserve it and stop for explicit owner diagnosis instead of rerun/overwrite.

ownerRecoveryAfterFailureOnly.then: Independently recheck entire authored files/FP and original GUID/journal restoration state. Keep original failed/timeout build result failed; source recovery is not new build success. No proof helper until a separate actual successful full build exists; no retry limit reset.

launcherPolicy.latestGuardRule: After each actual remote guard returns, recompute safeEnd=min(originalBatchStart+900, leaseDeadline-60); require positive sufficient remaining before each child and do not reset batch start.
launcherPolicy.timeoutRule: Use the shorter remaining safeEnd budget; stop only the process group created by this invocation; preserve actual exit/timeout/interrupt and all outputs.
launcherPolicy.guardRunIsNotAnExistingLeaseLauncher: cycle_guard.py run acquires its own lease; do not invoke it over a currently held lease. Only owner chooses and implements current controlled launch.
